rtt.name: NHS England, Referral to Treatment (RTT) waiting times, incomplete pathways by commissioner
rtt.measure: Incomplete pathways (patients still waiting) at month end. Median is NHS England's 'Average (median) waiting time (in weeks)'. 18 weeks is the constitutional standard, so the share waiting under 18 weeks is shown.

imd.name: English Indices of Deprivation 2025 (MHCLG), File 7 LSOA scores and population, with the ONS LSOA (2021) to ICB (April 2026) lookup
imd.measure: Population-weighted mean IMD score (mid-2022 population). Higher = more deprived. Rank 1 = most deprived of the 36 ICBs. Share = percentage of the ICB's LSOAs in the most deprived 10% nationally.
imd.method: Recomputed for the April 2026 ICBs because MHCLG's own ICB file (File 13) uses the 2024 boundaries. The same method reproduces File 13 on every ICB unchanged since 2024 (test_icb_pack.py).

items.name: NHSBSA English Prescribing Dataset with SNOMED code, BNF 13.02.01 and 21.22
items.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: NHS Business Services Authority.
items.measure: Brand share = the brand's items as a share of all emollient items prescribed in the ICB, 12 months. PCN variation = standard deviation, in percentage points, of that share across the ICB's Primary Care Networks (PCNs) with at least 200 emollient items in the 12 months (needs 5 such PCNs). PCN membership is the current NHS England Organisation Data Service membership applied to all 12 months.
